ko: K-Concert Trip 홍보 · 공연 전 체크 3가지
caption:
Going to a K-pop concert in Seoul? Check these 3 things first 👇

1. The nearest subway exit to the venue
2. The last train home
3. Where to leave your bag

Venue rules, hours and train schedules change, so always confirm with the organizer and official operators.
Plan your show day with K-Concert Trip, our own app on the App Store: venue guides and a show-day checklist.
